In this video, we explore how to work with different data types in PySpark — from Booleans and numbers to strings, regular expressions, dates, timestamps, and null values. You’ll see practical examples in Databricks using both PySpark DataFrame APIs and Spark SQL.
All code and data files are available on the below path:
What you’ll learn:
Handling Boolean operations in PySpark
Numeric functions and rounding examples
String transformations: lower, upper, trim, substring, split
Using Regex (Regular Expressions) for text extraction and replacement
